body:
It's quite the mouthful to read due to lack of punctuation.
```suggestion
			[b]Note:[/b] This property is not designed to be changed at run-time. However, after changing this property, calling [method CanvasItem.queue_redraw] on some nodes in the tree will partially work. Use [method Node.propagate_call] to propagate the call through the tree.
```
or:
```suggestion
			[b]Note:[/b] This property is not designed to be changed at run-time. However, after changing this property, propagating a call to [method CanvasItem.queue_redraw] will work on some nodes in the tree. See [method Node.propagate_call].
```

I don't disagree that it's redundant, but only in a way that plugs a knowledge gap someone is likely to have when they stumble across this.

My preference would be to keep it the way it is, as the clarity on this edge case is more useful, I find, than terseness.
